title: Multinomial PMF Integration with Mathlib Framework
description: Demonstrates integration of the multinomial distribution into Mathlib's PMF framework via Composition types and ENNReal normalization

meta.author: Formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib
meta.assumptions: No axioms. 7 sorries for: Fintype instance, ENNReal normalization, support characterization, marginal distributions, mean, covariance, and concrete example.
originalContributions: Composition type as support of multinomial distribution
PMF construction via multinomialPMFVal in ENNReal
Marginal distribution theorem: multinomial marginals are binomial
Feasibility analysis for Mathlib contribution (~200-300 lines)

overview.historicalContext: The multinomial distribution is fundamental in statistics and probability. Formalizing it in Mathlib's PMF framework would make it available for verified statistical reasoning.
overview.problemStatement: Can the multinomial distribution be integrated into Mathlib's PMF framework?
overview.text: The multinomial distribution can be constructed as a Mathlib PMF by defining a Composition type, lifting the multinomial theorem to ENNReal, and proving normalization
overview.proofStrategy: Define Composition as the support type, construct the PMF value function in ENNReal, prove normalization from the multinomial theorem, then derive properties (marginals, moments).
keyInsights: The multinomial theorem IS the normalization proof — this is the deep connection
The Composition type provides a clean interface between combinatorics and probability
ENNReal arithmetic is the main technical hurdle (no subtraction, division issues)

crossReferences.description: Answers OQ-01: 'Can the multinomial PMF be integrated into Mathlib's PMF framework?'

conclusion.summary: YES, the multinomial PMF can be integrated into Mathlib's PMF framework. The construction path is clear: Composition type → ENNReal normalization → PMF.mk → properties.
conclusion.implications: A complete implementation would be a valuable Mathlib contribution, enabling verified statistical reasoning about multinomial experiments.
openQuestions: Can the Fintype instance for Composition be proved efficiently using piAntidiag?
Can the entropy of the multinomial distribution be formalized?
